text:
rachel_cs: Heads up — Oxbridge AI onboarding demo next Wed 09:00-12:00 UTC. They're hitting 403/429s from CA region. Need temporary egress unlock + QPS bump to validate failover.

sam_net: Can you share IP ranges + desired qps? Do we want region pinning to ca-central-1 or just routing priority?

rachel_cs: QPS target: 180 requests/min (approx 3x current). Prefer pin to ca-central-1 for latency. IPs below for peered egress:```
54.172.12.0/24
34.86.45.128/26
209.123.11.0/24
```
Duration 72h with auto-revoke. Renewal at risk if demo fails — they're contract up for renewal in 3 weeks.

liam_se: We'll also need to pin their model routing to the canada pool so KV cache stays warm. I'll add a canary with 10% traffic then shift to 100% once warm. :thumbsup:

sam_net: ok creating ticket now, will request ephemeral rule in firewall and new route policy. tagging ops_oncall for approval. ticket: INFRA-4829

ops_oncall: looking — can approve temporary egress exception for 72h if there's auto-revoke. Please set start time window and an engineer oncall to monitor 200/500 rates.

rachel_cs: start window 2025-04-02T09:00:00Z — set monitor for 5% error threshold and rollback if breached. I'll be on the demo.

deploy-bot: INFRA-4829 status changed to in-progress by sam_net

sam_net: rule created and staged in prod: CIDR added, routing policy pinned to ca-central-1, qps limit bumped. Will flip at start time and auto-revert at +72h.

liam_se: Verified routing to canada nodes in staging. KV cache warming scheduled. I'll watch latency during ramp.

ops_oncall: Approved. Will be on watch for the window. If anything spikes ping #eng-oncall.

rachel_cs: thanks all — much appreciated. I'll follow up with customer feedback after demo. :rocket:
